title: Fix per-agent model selection
request: Settings per-agent model selection is broken: Claude Code lets you pick a model but the pick isn't enforced (the harness default runs) and its model list is stale (new models missing); every other harness offers no model choice at all and forces the default. Make the chosen model reach the harness in headless runs, and let every harness with known models be picked in Settings (fresh lists).

steps.title: Find how each harness receives the chosen model, and why Settings offers no model choice for non-Claude harnesses
Enforce the selected model on every harness (Claude --model, Codex -m, pi, ACP set_model) and refresh the model lists in Settings
Verify with tests, bh check, reinstall the mod
